role: A post-open control-attribution diagnostic using only the already sealed and independently validated v199 metric arrays. It asks whether v203's nine-camera physical-information rescue still requires the K2 reference or is already explained by an equal-or-lower exact-call control. It is not a new reconstruction, deployable initializer, validation or test result, resource result, external generalization, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Across all 13 calibrations and 101 frames of the opened p14 development trajectory, does the sealed all-nine-camera K2 reference pass every strict gate, and if so does any preregistered equal-or-lower exact-call classical or dense-representation control also pass all 1313 cells?
reason_for_priority: v203 independently showed that all nine views rescue all 24 audited five-camera failures under K2. Before building any learned variable-cardinality mechanism, v204 tests whether that headroom is already explained by a cheaper frozen control.

data_contract.trajectory_role: historically exposed post-open development diagnostic only
forbidden_inputs: post-result arm substitution or threshold changes

cost_accounting.operation: index and compare already sealed, independently validated all-nine-camera metrics
cost_accounting.cache_warning: The full-DCT and dual-ridge arms inherit a dense geometry cache and feature path; an exact-call count alone is not a wall, RSS, or deployment claim.

fixed_decision_order: Any parent identity, metadata, shape, global mask consistency, finite, source-clean, tree-seal, release, or independent-comparison failure makes v204 inconclusive.
If the all-nine-camera full_dct_k2_reference fails any of 1313 cells or 13 complete calibration groups, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_ALL_NINE_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V204.

If the reference passes and any pure_classical_controls arm passes all 1313 cells and 13 groups, conclude PASS_ALL_NINE_CLASSICAL_CONTROL_DOMINANCE_V204 and list every passing arm. This blocks a learned warm-start attribution on this opened all-nine condition.

Otherwise, if any dense_representation_controls arm with an equal-or-lower exact-call ledger passes all 1313 cells and 13 groups, conclude PASS_ALL_NINE_DENSE_REPRESENTATION_CALL_HEADROOM_V204. This is only post-open call-count headroom with inherited dense cache, not deployability or speed.
If only the K2 reference passes, conclude PASS_ALL_NINE_INFORMATION_WITHOUT_LOWER_COST_CONTROL_V204.
No outcome proves external generalization, real BOST, wall/RSS benefit, first/SOTA/global uniqueness, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: Do not change the arm roster, all-nine sensor, 1313-cell roster, strict limits, class assignment, or decision order after results. A classical-control result closes learned attribution on this opened all-nine condition; dense-only headroom authorizes only a separately frozen minimal cache-removal question; reference-only headroom does not authorize a large model.
